name: Fireworks AI
tagline: Fast inference API for open-source LLMs and multimodal models
description: Fireworks AI provides a high-performance inference API for open-source and proprietary large language models, image generation, embeddings, and fine-tuning. Developers call an OpenAI-compatible REST API at api.fireworks.ai for chat completions, text generation, and related model endpoints with serverless or dedicated deployments.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer header (or FIREWORKS_API_KEY). Self-serve signup at fireworks.ai; keys managed in account console.

use_cases: run chat completions with open-source LLMs
deploy fine-tuned models via serverless inference
